subject: Discovery recap & pilot timing check — FinBridge
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — FinBridge integration

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time earlier — appreciate the clear overview of FinBridge's latency-sensitive reconciliation use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- What we heard: run-time reconciliations (~200 reqs/min peak), PII in input (tokenization required), strict audit retention (12 months), target <200ms p95 for inference.
- Proposed approach: dedicated pool with prefix caching for common patterns, encryption-in-transit + KMS for keys, 30-day pilot using a 4-GPU pool to validate latency and accuracy.
- Success criteria: p95 <200ms, token cost <$0.002 average, no dropped requests during peak 1-hour window.

Action items:
1) Redwood: draft a short pilot proposal and SOW (attached: redwood_proposal_finbridge_v1.pdf).
2) FinBridge: confirm approximate budget band and legal/procurement contacts.
3) Both: pick dates for a 30–45 minute pilot kickoff (suggest week of Aug 4).

Two quick questions for you as we head toward the end of the quarter:
- Is the pilot/budget still on track for approval in the current quarter, or should we shift to a next-quarter timeline?
- Any constraints on bringing in your procurement person early (we can prepare SOC2 artifacts and a short security questionnaire)?

I've attached a short proposal and a link to the hubspot deal for reference.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier to decide.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposal_finbridge_v1.pdf (pdf)
